sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/lakesuperior ('this rustic campground offers 18 tent and small trailer sites') + amenity table (18 campsites), read 2026-10-22

note: Multiple sites right on Lake Superior. --AWH
summary: DNR park page + amenity table confirm $20/night, 18 rustic sites, first-come with no reservations, 15-day maximum, open all year (season already manual), vault toilets, hand-pump well water, no electric. Recreation Passport stays inherited. Max rig length not stated ('tent and small trailer sites').
